response: {"thought": "語意層與資料表都沒有「準時」的定義（shipments 沒有預計送達欄位），先檢查 2025 年第一季黑貓出貨單的筆數、未送達筆數與實際送達時間差，確認可用的資料範圍。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL OR delivered_ts = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_delivery, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_ship, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_ship FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'blackcat' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-04-01'", "SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'blackcat' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-04-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL"]}}
